name: Instant Photo
description: An instant print that develops while you watch: shadows first out of a grey-green haze, colours last.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture. A new src starts a new print.

props.name: alt
props.description: Describes the picture. It names the print for assistive technology.

props.name: caption
props.description: Written in the wide bottom margin.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the print takes to develop. Shaking it shortens this a little.

props.name: developed
props.description: Controls the print: true shows it developed, false holds it blank. Leave it out to let the print develop by itself when it appears.

props.name: eject
props.description: Plays the print sliding out of the camera slot before it starts to develop.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Resting angle in degrees, as if laid on a table.

props.name: onDeveloped
props.description: Called when a self-developing print is done.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the print. Set its width here; it is 14rem by default. Dragging it quickly, or pressing Space while it has focus, shakes it.
